<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern, the most distinctive feature is a strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak, which matches the characteristic chlorine isotopic distribution (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1). No other element shows such a definitive pattern (e.g., bromine would give an M+2 ≈ 100 % of the base, sulfur only ~4 %). Therefore, chlorine can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
